Delta Field Supply has no minimum order subtotal. Calibration buffers are sold as 500 ml bottles and seal kits as packs of four; requested quantities refer to the catalogue sales unit unless the requester explicitly says otherwise. Ask for clarification if a quantity could mean individual seals or packs. Written order acceptance starts the quoted lead time. Item subtotals therefore cannot be presented as final payable totals. Quoted lead times are working days from written order acceptance, not calendar days from a user query. The supplier operates Monday to Friday, excluding supplier holidays. The holiday calendar is not provided. Lead times are estimates, not guaranteed arrival dates. Live stock is not provided in the catalogue. ## Order process The minimum order subtotal for Estuary Instruments is INR 3000 before tax and shipping. Orders must include an SKU, quantity, delivery address and purchase-order reference. The assistant can prepare an informational item subtotal but cannot place an order, reserve inventory or issue a purchase order.
